prefsSaved: Default provider and profile models saved.
step0Intro: Choose whether this installation is a personal agent platform or a multi-organization knowledge product.
modeAgentDesc: Admin + users, one team — no separate organizations.
modeTenantDesc: Organizations, tenant admins, knowledge companion per firm.
step1Intro: Create the administrator account for this instance.
setupTokenEnv: Value from AGENT_SETUP_TOKEN in server config (.env).
setupTokenLog: One-time in server log after start (e.g. docker compose logs agent-layer).
passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Create more accounts under Admin → Users.
step2Intro: Detected providers from environment and config. Chat and embedding models are classified automatically; set default profiles here once. Bind cloud providers (OpenAI, Claude via OpenRouter, Groq, …) below as OpenAI-compatible endpoints. You can change models anytime in chat and Admin.
chatEmbedHint: Reuse a reachable chat provider URL for /v1/embeddings (saved in DB, no .env restart). Suggested model: {{model}}
chatEmbedBtn: Use chat provider for embeddings (RAG) too
showManualAdd: Add cloud or extra endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, …)
step3Intro: The instance is ready. Pick the model in the chat composer; adjust profiles and endpoints under Admin → Interfaces.
llmTestNoModels: Connection OK but no models reported. Check the endpoint or pick a model from the list.
llmPresetProvider1Help: OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. Set LLM_PROVIDER_1_BASE_URL in .env or enter the URL below.
llmPresetLlamaCppApiKeyHint: Only if your gateway requires an API key.
llmPresetLlamaCppHelp: Your llama.cpp or gateway endpoint with /v1/chat/completions.
llmPresetOpenaiHelp: Official OpenAI API. Model IDs like gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini.
llmPresetOpenrouterApiKeyHint: API key from openrouter.ai — one endpoint for many providers.

llmPresetTogetherHelp: Many open-source and hosted models via an OpenAI-compatible API.
